description: Needs sign-in: Find the person's documents by title or by one of their own tags: a case-insensitive match of the query anywhere in the title or a tag. It covers the documents they own and the documents shared with them, newest change first; not folders, archived documents or documents in the trash. Each entry has the document's id (pass it as documentId to read_document or to the compute tools), its title, its kind (notebook or plot) and the time of its last change (ISO 8601). "truncated": true means more documents matched than the limit.

query.description: Text to find in a title or a tag (case-insensitive). Not empty after trimming.

name: search_documents
title: Search my documents
